subject: RECORD clause (calculations to derive size of records on storage medium)
notes: Re-verdicted by kb/Work PB1540 (w67p). Arm (c)'s delimiter is now the host newline the determination states (the row's remaining ⚠ is gone). The determination also gains the fixed-length physical record rule (kb/Work PB1514: no record boundaries on the medium; the reading description's integer-1 bytes) and arm (c′), the record sequential print stream (CR LF line controls, a variable-length record presented at its GR13 length and refused '44' outside the VARYING bounds - kb/Work PB1190). Arm (a) holds (golden 85/pb1276_record_contains_sizes_file). || kb/Work PB1278 (wave 1140 A): arm (d), relative and indexed, rewritten for the keyed store engine's paged store format 6 (DESIGN-runtime-library 2.2.1.4; kb/Work PB3333-PB3335 deleted the whole-store header and its 0xFFFFFFFF empty-slot tag the arm still described): the file is a whole number of 4,096-byte pages; a relative record is one leaf entry of 6 + 8 + F bytes (F = 4 + the record's size, RecordFraming.EncodeFrame), an indexed record 6 + k + F in the prime tree (F carrying 8 bytes per key) and 6 + a + 8 + k in each alternate tree; a full leaf holds floor(4,064 / entry bytes); a frame over 1,016 bytes (or an entry over 2,032) goes to overflow pages. Witness unit:RelativeEngineTests.A_relative_records_size_on_the_medium_is_the_documented_leaf_entry_in_a_file_of_whole_pages pins the determination's example (100 80-byte records: 98-byte entries, 41 to a full leaf, 11 pages = 45,056 bytes).
